FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 91
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/23/2024
Senate Bill 91 as introduced would increase the current license tax and registration fees for
passenger and motorcycle registration by $5 with proceeds deposited into the Alabama Public
Transportation Trust Fund and used by the Alabama Department of Economic and Community
Affairs to increase public transportation options across the state.
Based upon a 5-year average of 5,191,839 passenger and motorcycle registrations, the $5
increase in the license tax and registration fee could increase the receipts into the Alabama
Public Transportation Trust Fund by an estimated $26 million annually.
